title: Detailed treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4a044'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a5a1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b07a2a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6e4514'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcf3a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow from inside the chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='34' ry='10' fill='#ffe873' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- treasure pile peeking out -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffe36b'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='41' r='4.5' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='42' r='4' fill='#fff09a'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ffe36b'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#fff09a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#fff09a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#ffe36b'/>

  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='64' height='36' rx='3' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge of body -->
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='64' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c89544'/>

  <!-- vertical plank lines -->
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='2' height='30' fill='#5c3a10'/>
  <rect x='44' y='52' width='2' height='30' fill='#5c3a10'/>
  <rect x='58' y='52' width='2' height='30' fill='#5c3a10'/>
  <rect x='72' y='52' width='2' height='30' fill='#5c3a10'/>

  <!-- metal bands on body -->
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='4' height='30' fill='#9fb6c9'/>
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='1.5' height='30' fill='#d3e2ee'/>
  <rect x='74' y='52' width='4' height='30' fill='#9fb6c9'/>
  <rect x='74' y='52' width='1.5' height='30' fill='#d3e2ee'/>

  <!-- chest lid (curved) -->
  <path d='M18 48 Q18 26 50 26 Q82 26 82 48 Z' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <path d='M24 44 Q24 31 50 31 Q76 31 76 44' fill='none' stroke='#e8bc66' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- lid metal bands -->
  <path d='M26 48 Q26 30 50 30 Q50 30 50 30 L50 48 Z' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M24 48 Q24 32 31 29 L34 31 Q29 35 29 48 Z' fill='#9fb6c9'/>
  <path d='M76 48 Q76 32 69 29 L66 31 Q71 35 71 48 Z' fill='#9fb6c9'/>

  <!-- lid seam / band across middle -->
  <rect x='18' y='44' width='64' height='5' fill='#a87828'/>
  <rect x='18' y='44' width='64' height='1.5' fill='#d4a044'/>

  <!-- lock plate -->
  <rect x='42' y='43' width='16' height='18' rx='3' fill='#c9d8e4'/>
  <rect x='42' y='43' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#eef5fa'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='3' fill='#3a4a5a'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='51' width='3' height='6' fill='#3a4a5a'/>

  <!-- keyhole glow accent -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#a8c4d8'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='22' y='82' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8a5a1a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='82' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8a5a1a'/>
  <rect x='22' y='82' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b07a2a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='82' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b07a2a'/>

  <!-- corner bolts -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#d3e2ee'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#d3e2ee'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#d3e2ee'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#d3e2ee'/>
</svg>
